study type: Multi-cohort study with cross-sectional and longitudinal individual patient data (IPD) analyses
cohort: The study included 21,714 individuals from eight cohorts, providing second and third trimester fetal ultrasound measurements and birth measurements.
finding: Individuals from the highest household income category, compared to those with the lowest, consistently exhibited larger head size and higher weight in the second trimester, third trimester, and at birth, with these differences often widening as pregnancy progressed.
cross-section timing: Second trimester, third trimester, and at birth
birth_weight: Measured at birth; higher weight observed in highest HI category.
